During World War II, Romania developed its own submachine gun: the Orița M1941! Built to reduce dependence on foreign weapons, this sturdy 9mm SMG featured a 32-round magazine and a firing rate of around 600 rounds per minute. Although produced in relatively small numbers, it remained in Romanian service long after WWII!
